quote: FEJ also regulated the osteoclast formation including Lilrb4a , Ncf2 , Ncf1 , Pira12 , Pira1 , Lilra6 and Pirb .
summary: Lilra6 is one of several osteoclast-formation genes regulated by a herbal formula in anemic mice; nothing about colitis.

quote: Furthermore, both LILRA2 and LILRA6 activated JAK-STAT, NF-κB, PI3K/AKT and ERK1/2 MAPK signaling pathways and induced Th1-, Th2- and Th17-type cytokines and Toll-like receptors.
summary: Overexpressing chicken LILRA6 in HD11 macrophages activated signaling pathways and induced cytokines; this is an avian cell study with no colitis outcome.

quote: Notably, LILRB3 and LILRA6 within this cluster exhibit pronounced sequence homology in immunoglobulin-like domains involved in ligand binding and variable copy number (CN) states.
summary: A tool for calling LILRB3-LILRA6 copy number haplotypes from whole-genome data; IBD is named only as a future association target, with no association tested.

quote: Multiple genes as tagged by the top 5 probes, including IFNAR2, TRIM5, NLRC5, MCTP1, PTPN1, FCER1G, ATF4 and PON2 , were involved in inflammation or antiviral immunity (Table S2).
summary: MCTP1 is one of several genes tagged by top probes in a COVID-19 Mendelian randomisation study; nothing about UC.
Mctp1 here is a rodent mast cell protease (Mcpt1 type), not the MCTP1 gene.
Mctp1 here denotes mast cell protease 1, not the multiple C2 domain transmembrane protein 1 gene.
MCTP1 appears only as the lncRNA MCTP1 or MCTP1-AS1 acting on miR-650 in cancer, not as the protein-coding gene.
Only the lncRNA MCTP1-AS1 sponging miR-650 in cancer is mentioned, not the MCTP1 gene.

quote: Several genes, including BATF2, SERPINB9, FCGR2A, MCTP1, SNX30, and SMIM1, were identified as having a causal relationship with CD.
summary: Mendelian randomisation using eQTLs links MCTP1 expression causally to Crohn's disease, with no stated direction, and UC is not tested.

quote: A 3-study meta-analysis of 3,683 nonoverlapping cases and 14,507 extended controls on >2.3 M genotyped and imputed SNPs resulted in 3 chromosomal regions with association P approximately 10(-7): 1p31.1 (no known genes), 3p21 (>25 known genes), and 5q15 (MCTP1).
summary: A bipolar disorder GWAS meta-analysis found a suggestive association at the 5q15 locus containing MCTP1; unrelated to UC.

quote: PH domain-containing protein ( PP9099, BC008744 ; see Table 4 ) was up-regulated in both diseases on the microarray, but our microarray cutoff criteria were not reached in the CD population.
summary: PP9099 (PLEKHO2) was upregulated in UC and CD sigmoid biopsies on cDNA microarray, but was not significant in the inflamed colon cohort on follow-up.

quote: Thirteen proteins were significantly downregulated KRT1, KRT5, KRT6A, KRT10 (all keratins), SLC44A2 (sugar/choline transport), PTGIS (cytochrome 450 protein), ARL3 (GTP-binding protein), H2AFX (replication independent histone), TSPO (steroid hormone synthesis), ACO1 (aconitase; iron metabolism), PSMB10 (proteasome), PLEKHO2 (innate immune system) and RPS13 (ribosomal protein) ( Table 4 ).
summary: PLEKHO2 is one of 13 proteins downregulated in a mesenchymal cell line exposed to Crohn's disease patient serum, with no gene-specific result.

quote: Using a conditional knock-out of Fam65b , an atypical inhibitor of the small G protein RHOA, it has been revealed that T cell-specific deletion of Fam65b (CD4Cre) goes along with alterations of T cell migration in a RHOA-dependent mechanism [ 85 ].
summary: A Rho GTPase review notes that T cell-specific Fam65b (RIPOR2) deletion alters T cell migration via RHOA; no colitis outcome is described.

summary: RIPOR2 is one of several genes upregulated in PBMCs relative to cerebrospinal fluid in tuberculous meningitis; nothing about UC.

quote: Pink1 inhibits autophagy through the phosphorylating family with sequence similarity 65 member B (FAM65B) ( 115 ).
summary: A stroke circRNA and autophagy review mentions FAM65B (RIPOR2) as a Pink1 phosphorylation target; no UC data.

quote: Further analysis of disease risk genes and drug-ready genes identified three additional intersection genes: EIF2AK1, RIPOR2, and SLC29A4.
summary: RIPOR2 is one of three drug-susceptible intersection genes in an iridocyclitis multi-trait GWAS; no gene-specific result and no UC data.

quote: a plasma milieu enriched with vWF, FAM65B, and the Afamin
summary: FAM65B (RIPOR2) is named among plasma proteins enriched alongside a procoagulant platelet state; context is not UC and no gene-specific result is given.

quote: annotated in genes related to psychiatric disorders (ZFP57, POLD4, TRIM10, GAS7, ADORA2A, TOLLIP), trauma exposure (RIPOR2) and inflammatory/immune responses (LAT, DLX4, POLD4, FAM30A, H19)
summary: RIPOR2 is named as one of several differentially methylated regions after electroconvulsive therapy in women; unrelated to UC.

quote: In addition, we identify RIPOR2 as a glucocorticoid-regulated protein associated with Rho GTPase signaling networks and actin cytoskeletal remodeling in neutrophils and neutrophil-like cells, though its exact functional role requires further investigation.
summary: Proteomics found RIPOR2 regulated by glucocorticoids in neutrophil-like cells, linked to Rho GTPase and actin networks; its function was not tested and UC is not studied.

summary: A structural sequence analysis of the TMTC1-4 family concluding they are O-mannosyltransferases; no disease or UC data.
